extraction_notes: Table 2 was not extracted because it reports nitrogen isotopic exchange, not NH3 synthesis from N2/H2. Figure 1c was not extracted because it reports mass-spectrometric signal intensities for 15NH3 formation rather than a rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF. Figure 1a and Figure 5b are time-course plots with many closely spaced points; exact tabulated values are not provided in the supplied text, so only the clearer table/text/bar/temperature/pressure-series values were extracted, with plotted values marked '~'. Literature values explicitly cited from other papers in the discussion (for example the reported Cs−Ru/MgO ENH3 = ca. 0.8 vol % from ref. 22) were not extracted.
